children: French insurer Axa is on course to improve its valuation by integrating artificial intelligence faster than rivals, Citi's James Shuck writes. "We remain very positive on the Axa share story and expect the company to rerate as it continues to deliver low volatility, diverse growth in the context of contained controllable cost inflation," Shuck says. Citi has a buy rating on the stock and a 50.40-euro target price. Shares are up 0.7% at 43.96 euros and are 7.3% higher over the year to date. (joseph.wilkins@wsj.com)
